verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle as a strong focal point and the headline readable, but the bottle has lost its cream circle backdrop: that circle now sits on its own in the bottom-left corner, with a faint stray circle top-left. The bottle also crowds the end of the headline, and the NEW/Try It column on the right floats loosely. B shrinks the bottle to an icon-sized speck in the bottom-right, which loses the key product image. It also leaves the orphaned cream circle bottom-left and centres the headline slightly off-axis from the NEW pill and CTA, with large dead areas, so it reads as a sparse, unintentional layout.
